About Locke Family Dentistry

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Poppins||||||||” text_text_color=”#FFFFFF” text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” link_font=”||||on||||” link_text_color=”#FFFFFF” text_font_size_tablet=”” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

At Locke Family Dentistry, we believe that every patient deserves to enjoy a healthy, functional, and beautiful smile. That’s why we proudly provide preventative, cosmetic, restorative, and even TMJ treatments from our comprehensive dentist in Pineville, LA. Our dental professionals have the skills and experience to provide personalized treatments to every patient, no matter the severity of their condition.

We also believe that treatment costs shouldn’t stand in your way of achieving your smile goals. Our Pineville office accepts a host of dental insurance plans, and our friendly staff will file your claim for you to ensure you receive the maximum benefits. Dental insurance isn’t a requirement to receive treatment at our practice, which is why we also accept payment through CareCredit.

Our Pineville, LA dentist Dr. Virginia Locke has been providing friendly, professional dental care since she joined the practice in 2005. Dr. Locke received her Doctorate of Dental Surgery from LSU School of Dentistry in 2004 and is a member of the American Dental Association.

Since joining the practice, she’s been continuing her dental education to provide the best dental care to patients in Central Louisiana. As a caring and experienced dental professional, Dr. Locke is equipped to help support and transform your oral health and wellness.
